_note: Monte Carlo input ranges (spec §5b). status: from_layer3 = recomputed from Sayari exposure once available; from_layer2 = calibrated from CBP statistics; placeholder = structural default awaiting data, shown with a badge on the page. Every range can be edited on the page.

step_increments_placeholder._note: Added flagged share of US cell+module import value at each threshold step, in percentage points (triangular low/mode/high). PLACEHOLDER until the Layer 3 Sayari classification exists. Not data.

inputs.label: True-exposure rate · high-confidence flags
inputs.represents: Share of flagged supply that really contains the targeted input, for high-confidence flags (E0)
inputs.source: Structural: narrow band because listing is a matter of public record (spec §5b).

inputs.label: True-exposure rate · medium-confidence flags
inputs.represents: The same for E1–E3 trade links
inputs.source: Structural: medium width. Will be tightened by M7 spot checks of Sayari source records.

inputs.label: True-exposure rate · low-confidence flags
inputs.represents: The same for ownership-adjacent and research-named flags
inputs.source: Structural: wide band. Single-hop ownership and research mentions are weak evidence of content.

inputs.label: Hidden exposure
inputs.represents: Exposed share of supply where trade data is missing, in pp of the market at full depth
inputs.source: Coverage gap: the untraced share × an unknown exposure rate. Wide by default (spec §5b). Linked to rerouting via the copula.

inputs.label: Enforcement probability
inputs.represents: Chance that a genuinely exposed shipment is stopped once the rule reaches it
inputs.source: To be calibrated against CBP detentions at the current setting (T1) once Layer 3 exists.

inputs.label: Release rate
inputs.represents: Share of detained goods later released
inputs.source: Replaced by CBP released ÷ (released + denied) when Layer 2 stats are present.

inputs.label: Rerouting / evasion
inputs.represents: Share of blocked supply that comes back in through other routes (transshipment)
inputs.source: Wide range. To be sourced from enforcement cases and Southeast Asia transshipment research.

inputs.label: Replacement capacity
inputs.represents: Percentage points of US market supply that clean suppliers can add per month, once ramped
inputs.source: Industry capacity estimates still to be sourced (US and non-China module/cell build-out).

inputs.label: Ramp-up delay
inputs.represents: Months before replacement capacity starts arriving
inputs.source: Sector assumption (rules: 6–18 months to qualify a supplier). To be sourced.

inputs.label: Inventory buffer
inputs.represents: Months of total US supply already in the pipeline or in warehouses
inputs.source: Range from industry/trade sources still to be sourced.

model: removed_j = Σ_{k≤j} Δ_k · τ(conf_k) · p_enf · (1 − release) · (1 − reroute)  +  hidden · depth_j · p_enf · (1 − release) · (1 − reroute)
depth_j = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1 for T0…T5: how much hidden (untraced) exposure a rule at that depth would surface
significant disruption ⇔ removed_j > X% of US market supply (default X = 20)
refill_months = ramp + removed / capacity;  buffer_cover = buffer × 100 / removed;  shortage_months = max(0, refill_months − buffer_cover)
